Author: Infi, Anna
Name: Chat2Ex
Description:
Chat2Ex is a complete rewrite of the in-game chat window as a plugin.
It supports:

- Unlimited tabs
- Tabs that always send to a certain channel
- More flexible filtering
- RGB channel colouring
- Completely variable font size
- Sidebar tabs
- Unread counts
- Emotes
- Screenshot mode (obfuscate names)
Punchline: Electric Boogaloo - ♪ A whole new chat, a new fantastic chat window ♪
Changelog:
**1.41.5**
- Fixed a crash caused by rebuilding the tab bar (and disposing native nodes) on every chat message; unread counts and selection now update in place
- Added in-place tab label/selection APIs to KamiToolKit

**1.41.4**
- Restored the ImGui Settings window (12 tabs), DbViewer with date/channel/paging filters and TXT/JSON/HTML export, Debugger and SeString Debugger
- All context menus and the channel picker are now ImGui popups; native addon menus are no longer created from game callbacks
- Restored the ImGui font system, auto-translate completion, /chat2 hide|show|toggle and /clearlog2 all|help
- Wired up pretty/compact timestamps, duplicate-message collapsing, auto-translate sorting and screenshot-mode obfuscation
- Chat icons (sprout, mentor, ...) now use the game's own SeString icon macro: identical to the vanilla client, no black boxes and no managed texture ownership
- Fixed a native crash from releasing a texture the plugin did not own; addon teardown is now synchronous on unload

**1.41.3**
- Fixed crashes caused by unguarded framework/UI callbacks and RunOnTick handlers
- Fixed the AtkValue release crash when selecting chat context menu items
- The top-right button now opens Settings directly; the tab context menu was removed
- Added window width/height to Settings > Display, applied immediately on save
- Moved window opacity / lock / position options from Chat Log to Display

**New Feature Added~**
- A web interface has been added
- *This will not function if your game client is offline or you are logged out of the game*

**Main Features**
- View in-game chat on any device that has a web browser functionality
- Can send chat messages through the web interface directly into the game itself
- Easily copy & paste messages
- Option for automatic starting the web interface feature
- Log lines render limit for faster loading performance [Default 1000]

**Security**
- This feature is not intended to be used outside of your local, private network
- Do not forward ports that are described inside the chat2 options panel
- Never share your authentication code under any circumstances
- Multi-box support is not provided, the web interface will track only the first client

**Additional Features soon to be Added**
- Display errors as small notifications inside the web interface

**Planned Features**
- Multiple Tabs support
- Browser specific settings
- Stylization support

**Additional Permissions Note**
- Users that wish to expand this to apps or other platforms are welcome to do so

*Note: An FAQ will be provided in the chat2 thread on the dalamud discord, linked in the About section*
